name: morphazoid
description: Morphazoid - geometric instruments for shape, lattice, spatial forms, and live audio loops.

scripts.check: for file in app.js nav.js *-app.js wax-page.js src/*.js; do node --check $file || exit 1; done; node --check scripts/julia-similarity-report.mjs; node --check scripts/mix-catalogue-icons.mjs; node --check scripts/fingerprint-dentaphone.mjs; node --check scripts/fingerprint-hiccup-head.mjs; node --check scripts/build-release-site.mjs; node --check scripts/build-wax-site.mjs; node --check scripts/check-wax-dist.mjs; node --check scripts/check-storybook-artifact.mjs; node --check scripts/wax/wax-host-bootstrap.js; node --check scripts/wax/wax-host-bridge.js; node --check scripts/wax/wax-universal-adapter.js
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run check:wax-dist
scripts.test:browser:audit: playwright test e2e/control-inventory.spec.mjs e2e/shared-consistency.spec.mjs e2e/responsive.spec.mjs e2e/accessibility.spec.mjs e2e/shared-legacy-control-geometry.spec.mjs
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build:site && npm run build:storybook -- --output-dir dist/storybook
